lines.rom: jaya jaya ambe jaya katyayani jaya jaga mata jaga ki maharani baijanatha sthana tumhara vaham varadati nama pukara
kai nama haim kai dhama haim yaha sthana bhi to sukhadhama hai hara mandira mem jyota tumhari kahi yogesvari mahima nyari
hara jagaha utsava hote rahate hara mandira mem bhagata hai kahate katyani raksaka kaya ki granthi kate moha maya ki
jhuthe moha se churane vali apana nama japane vali brhaspativara ko puja kariye dhyana katyani ka dhariye
hara samkata ko dura karegi bhandare bharapura karegi jo bhi mam ko bhakta pukare katyayani saba kasta nivare
